drums.tags: Ambient field recording of a natural environment. The soundscape is dominated by the rhythmic, high-pitched chirping of crickets and cicadas, creating a dense, continuous wall of sound. A low-frequency wind rumble occasionally passes through the microphone, accompanied by the rustling of leaves and grass. The recording features a wide stereo image with distinct insect sounds positioned at various points in the panoramic field. There are no melodic or harmonic instruments present. The dynamic range is narrow, maintaining a consistent level of environmental white noise. The recording captures the acoustic characteristics of an open outdoor space at night.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[low-frequency wind rumble, distant insect chirping]

[Main Section]
[dense, rhythmic cricket and cicada chirping]
[intermittent rustling of leaves and grass]
[occasional wind gusts hitting the microphone diaphragm]

bass.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a palm-muted, syncopated riff in E minor at 120 BPM. The drum kit features a prominent double-kick pedal pattern and a dry, high-tuned snare. An overdriven bass guitar mirrors the guitar riff with aggressive pick attack. The arrangement utilizes a 4/4 time signature. Lead guitar layers include a wah-pedal filtered solo with rapid alternate picking and wide vibrato. The production is dry with minimal reverb on the rhythm section.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, palm-muted eighth notes]
[bass guitar enters, overdriven tone]

[Main Theme]
[full drum kit enters, double-kick pedal pattern]
[syncopated power chord accents]

[Guitar Solo]
[lead guitar with wah-pedal effect]
[rapid alternate picking and pinch harmonics]

[Outro]
